document_name: AB-2025-02456-RFP #25-004ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review_Final (1).pdf

extracted_fields.rfp_contact: Indra Ghosh, Supervisor of Purchasing and Treasury (PublicBids@rockyview.ca)
extracted_fields.submission_method: Electronic submission via email to PublicBids@rockyview.ca
extracted_fields.contract_term: From date of official acceptance until December 31, 2025, with option to renew for up to 1 additional year up to a total period not exceeding 3 years.
extracted_fields.scope_of_deliverables: ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, development of RFP scope of work document, and advisory services for the ERP evaluation and selection process.
extracted_fields.mandatory_submission_requirements: Completion and submission of signed Submission Form (Appendix B), Pricing Schedule (Section F/Appendix C), and Mandatory Evaluation Table (Section B.3).
extracted_fields.mandatory_technical_requirements: Must meet requirements outlined in Mandatory Evaluation Table (Understanding of Scope, Proposed Methodology, Schedule, Team Credentials, Previous Similar Work, Budgetary Control within 10% variance, Insurance and References).
extracted_fields.evaluation_criteria: Proponent's Experience and Qualifications (10%), Service Team Qualifications and Experience (25%), Client References and Past Experience (10%), Work Plan, Methodology, and Quality Assurance (30%), Pricing (25%). Total: 100 points.
extracted_fields.pricing_requirements: Task-Fee Schedule (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) in CAD, inclusive of all labour, equipment, materials, travel, and overhead (excluding applicable sales taxes).
extracted_fields.minimum_insurance_requirements: Required Insurance Certificate (specific dollar limits not explicitly detailed in body text; standard vendor agreement applies).
extracted_fields.vendor_experience_qualifications: Project Manager: minimum 5 years experience on ERP projects and led at least 2 ERP projects in last 7 years. Team members: minimum 3 years experience on ERP projects in last 7 years.
extracted_fields.number_of_references_required: Minimum of three (3) client references (preferably public sector/municipal within last 7 years).
extracted_fields.data_security_privacy_requirements: Compliance with data governance, security protocols, role-based access controls, encryption, audit trails, and data protection regulations.
extracted_fields.data_hosting_residency_requirements: Assessment of data residency requirements and compliance with relevant regulations for cloud-stored data.
extracted_fields.vendor_demonstration_requirement: Yes, shortlisted proponents may be called for a 2nd level interview and product presentation/demonstration.
